newsitem.title: USA: Reliance says calls for note redemption.
newsitem.headline: Reliance says calls for note redemption.

text.p: Reliance Group's Reliance Financial Services Corp said Friday it is calling for the redemption of all its outstanding 7.866 percent senior reset notes, principal amount $25 million, due December 1, 2000.
The company said the redemption price will be 100 percent of the principal amount plus interest from June 1 to the July 8 redemption date.
The company said the redemption agent is LaSalle National Bank.
Reliance Financial Services is a wholly owned subsidary of Reliance Group Holdings Inc.
